name: VoxPopuli: Large-Scale Multilingual Speech Corpus
description: VoxPopuli is a large-scale multilingual speech corpus for representation learning, semi-supervised learning, and speech translation. Extracted from European Parliament plenary session recordings (2009-2020), it provides 400,000 hours of unlabeled speech across 23 languages and 1,800 hours of transcribed audio.
